sub_sector.value: On-demand custom parts manufacturing and rapid prototyping

manufacturing_type.detail: Digital factories and manufacturing partners provide CNC machining, injection molding, additive manufacturing, and sheet metal fabrication.

production_model.detail: Customers upload CAD files and configure materials and lead times. Manufacturing starts after they place an order.

product_complexity.detail: Custom parts with tight machining tolerances, repeatable additive production, and critical-to-quality inspections for injection molding.

production_role.detail: Manufacturing partner for customer-designed prototype parts and end-use components, with program management for production orders.

end_market_exposure.detail: Aerospace components, traditional and electric vehicles, industrial jigs and fixtures, consumer and computer electronics, and medical devices.
